entries.title: Leviticus 23:1
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 23:2
segments: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, The feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim, holy convocations, even these are My appointed feasts.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:3
segments: Six days shall work be done, but the seventh day [is] the sabbath of rest, a holy convocation. You shall not do any work. It [is] a sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:4
segments: These [are] the appointed feasts of the LORD, holy convocations which you shall proclaim in their appointed seasons.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:5
segments: In the fourteenth [day] of the first month, between the evenings, is the LORD's Passover,

entries.title: Leviticus 23:6
segments: and on the fifteenth day of the same month [is] the Feast of Unleavened [Bread] to the LORD. You must eat unleavened [bread] seven days.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:7
segments: On the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no work of labor,

entries.title: Leviticus 23:8
segments: but you shall offer a fire offering to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day [is] a holy convocation. You shall do no work of labor.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:9
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 23:10
segments: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap the harvest of it, then you shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest to the priest.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:11
segments: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD to be received for you. On the next day after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:12
segments: And you shall offer that day when you wave the sheaf, a male lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:13
segments: And its food offering [shall be] two-tenth parts of fine flour mixed with oil, a fire offering to the LORD for a sweet savor. And the drink offering of it [shall be] of wine, the fourth [part] of a hin.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:14
segments: And you shall eat neither bread, nor parched grain, nor green ears, until the same day, until you have brought an offering to your God. [It shall be] a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:15
segments: And you shall count to you from the next day after the sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:16
segments: To the next day after the seventh sabbath you shall number fifty days. And you shall offer a new food offering to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:17
segments: You shall bring out of your homes two wave loaves of two-tenth parts. They shall be of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, firstfruits to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:18
segments: And you shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bull, and two rams. They shall be [for] a burnt offering to the LORD, with their food offering, and their drink offerings, a fire offering of sweet savor to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:19
segments: Then you shall sacrifice one he-goat for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:20
segments: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits, a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:21
segments: And you shall proclaim on the same day [that] it may be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no work of labor. [It shall be] a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:22
segments: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not completely reap the corner of your field. When you reap the gleaning of your harvest, you shall not gather. You shall leave them to the poor and to the stranger. I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:23
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 23:24
segments: Speak to the sons of Israel saying: In the seventh month, in the first [day] of the month, you shall have a sabbath, a memorial summons, a holy convocation.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:25
segments: You shall do no work of labor but you shall offer a fire offering to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:26
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 23:27
segments: Also, on the tenth of this seventh month, this is a day of atonement. [It shall be] a holy convocation to you. And you shall afflict your souls and offer a fire offering to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:28
segments: And you shall do no work in that same day, for it [is] a day of atonement, in order to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:29
segments: For any soul who is not humbled in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:30
segments: And any soul who does any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:31
segments: You shall do no kind of work. [It shall be] a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:32
segments: It [shall be] to you a sabbath of rest, and you shall humble your souls. In the ninth of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your sabbath.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:33
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 23:34
segments: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month [shall be] the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:35
segments: On the first day [shall be] a holy convocation. You shall do no work of labor.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:36
segments: Seven days you shall offer a fire offering to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. And you shall offer a fire offering to the LORD. It [is] a solemn assembly. And you shall do no work of labor.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:37
segments: These [are] the feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer a fire offering to the LORD, a burnt offering and a food offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, everything on its day;

entries.title: Leviticus 23:38
segments: besides the sabbath of the LORD, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your free-will offerings which you give to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:39
segments: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruit of the land, you shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days. On the first day [shall be] a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:40
segments: And you shall take the fruit of majestic trees for yourselves on the first day, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook. And you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:41
segments: And you shall keep it a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. [It shall be] a statute forever in your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:42
segments: You shall live in booths seven days. All that are born Israelites shall live in booths,

entries.title: Leviticus 23:43
segments: so that your generations may know that I made the sons of Israel live in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 23:44
segments: And Moses declared the feasts of the LORD to the sons of Israel.
